hook.support_html: The CIA published the PM job description of 2035. Then OpenAI shipped AGENTS.md — scope, permissions, memory, escalation. Same artifact, different format.

code.title: What the spec actually looks like.
body_lines: Triage inbound support from enterprise accounts.
- mentions: legal | compliance | renewal

fields.name: Scope
fields.definition: What this agent is FOR. Not what it can do.
fields.eng: Routes tickets via classifier v3.2 at 94% accuracy.
fields.pm: Triages enterprise support. Escalates billing-urgent only.
fields.takeaway_html: Confuse capability with scope and you ship an agent that technically works and commercially fails.

fields.name: Permissions
fields.definition: Which systems. Whose credentials. Under what conditions.
fields.eng: Service account with R/W on Postgres, OAuth read on Salesforce.
fields.pm: Reads tickets. Writes internal queue. Never touches billing.
fields.takeaway_html: The engineer describes what is possible. The PM describes what is permitted. The second doc is what ships.

fields.name: Memory
fields.definition: What the agent remembers. And what it must forget.
fields.eng: Context window 128K. Vector store with 30-day TTL.
fields.pm: Per-session only. No cross-customer context. Forget at session end.
fields.takeaway_html: One team I know shipped unscoped memory. Three weeks later a Fortune-100 pricing conversation leaked into a support reply. Memory scope is a product decision.

fields.name: Escalation
fields.definition: An enumerated trip-wire list. Not a mood.
fields.eng: Escalate when confidence < 0.7 or intent is ambiguous.
fields.pm: Any action > $500. Every enterprise tier. Legal, compliance, renewal.
fields.takeaway_html: Confidence scores protect the model. An enumerated list protects the business.

pattern.title: Both labs shipped the same discipline in 48 hours.

card_left.desc: Scope, permissions, memory, escalation — configured at the root of every deployment.

card_right.desc: A configurable limit on effort before the agent hands back. "Try this hard. Then check in."

pattern.closer_html: Two labs. 48 hours. Same pattern: configurable discipline for agents. It's no longer one lab's opinion — it's the default.

cta.question: What's in the first line of YOUR team's AGENTS.md?
cta.closer: Curious where teams are landing — reply with the first line you'd ship.

bonus.title: Screenshot. Fill in. Ship by Friday.
bonus.intro: The 4-field starter. Paste it at the root of your next agent deployment and fill the blanks before any tool-call code gets written.
bonus.outro_html: If this was useful — follow for more PM × AI frameworks. More AGENTS.md-style specs every week.
